a.text: The squadron was established as Patrol Squadron 22 (VP-22).

b.text: VP-22 was established at NAAS Harvey Point, North Carolina.
VP-42 was disestablished at NAS Whidbey Island.

a.text: The squadron was recalled to NAS Kaneohe Bay.

b.text: The squadron was assigned to NAS San Diego, California.

a.text: Upon its return to the U.S., the squadron was based at NAS Whidbey Island, Washington.

b.text: The squadron was assigned the SP-2H aircraft.

a.text: NAS Whidbey Island became its new official home port.

b.text: The squadron was assigned to NAS Whidbey Island, Washington.

a.text: The squadron was assigned the PBM-3D aircraft.

b.text: The squadron was assigned to NAS Alameda, California.
